product.name: HelpingHand AI
product.category: Enterprise B2B Revenue Intelligence & Autonomous CRM
product.tagline: The self-driving CRM that turns sales conversations into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.
product.overview: HelpingHand AI combines real-time conversational AI, automated pipeline governance, and autonomous lead qualification to reduce rep administrative burden by 80% while accelerating sales velocity.

pricing.model: Per seat / billed annually (monthly billing available at 15% surcharge)

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.idealFor: Early-stage sales teams (1-5 reps) needing modern CRM basics without complex setup
features: Core pipeline & contact management
Automated email & calendar bi-directional sync (Gmail & Outlook)
Basic lead scoring & task automation
Standard email & chat support
Up to 10,000 active contacts

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.idealFor: Scaling SaaS companies (5-30 reps) requiring real-time conversational AI and automated qualification
features: Everything in Starter plus:
Autonomous AI Voice & Chat Qualification Agent
Real-time BANT qualification & sentiment analysis
Automated meeting scheduling & calendar hold injection
Custom sales sequence workflows & playbooks
HubSpot 1-click automated bi-directional migration
Advanced analytics, win-rate forecasts & pipeline health alerts
Priority support with 4-hour SLA

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.idealFor: Mid-market & enterprise revenue organizations (30+ reps) with custom compliance & governance needs
features: Everything in Growth plus:
Dedicated Solutions Engineer & white-glove migration assistance
SOC 2 Type II compliance pack & custom BAA agreements for HIPAA
Enterprise SSO (SAML 2.0, Okta, Azure AD) & SCIM provisioning
Custom AI model fine-tuning with zero-data-retention guarantee
Dedicated Customer Success Manager & 99.99% uptime SLA
Role-based access control (RBAC) & immutable audit logging
Unlimited custom integrations via Webhooks & GraphQL API

discounts.multiYearCommitment: Custom volume pricing available for teams exceeding 50 seats

securityCompliance.soc2Status: SOC 2 Type II Certified (Audited annually by Schellman & Co.)
certifications: SOC 2 Type II (Security, Availability, and Confidentiality trust principles)
HIPAA Compliant with standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA)

dataProtection.encryptionAtRest: AES-256 bit encryption across all databases and customer storage volumes
dataProtection.encryptionInTransit: TLS 1.3 enforced for all API, voice streaming, and web traffic
dataProtection.keyManagement: AWS KMS / GCP Cloud KMS with optional customer-managed keys (BYOK) on Enterprise
dataProtection.dataResidency: Regional data hosting available in US-East (N. Virginia), EU (Frankfurt), and APAC (Tokyo)

aiPrivacyGuarantee.trainingPolicy: HelpingHand AI STRICTLY DOES NOT use customer tenant data, voice recordings, or transcripts to train public AI foundation models.
aiPrivacyGuarantee.retention: Voice audio streams are processed in ephemeral memory buffers and purged immediately post-transcription unless customer enables compliance archiving.

hubspotMigration.supportLevel: Full turnkey migration supported with 1-click wizard or white-glove engineering
hubspotMigration.migrationTime: Under 45 minutes for typical instances (< 250,000 records)
capabilities: 1-Click Automated Connector via HubSpot OAuth 2.0 app
Complete historical preservation: Contacts, Companies, Deals, Custom Properties, Notes, and Call Recordings
Zero Downtime Guarantee: Dual-sync capability allows teams to test HelpingHand AI while HubSpot runs simultaneously with zero lead leakage
Pre-flight schema mapping & automated data cleansing (deduplication of duplicate contacts and invalid emails)
Complimentary 14-day transition overlap period with no double billing
hubspotMigration.onboardingSupport: Teams with 15+ seats receive a dedicated Migration Engineer who manages schema validation, workflow reproduction, and team training workshops.

salesObjectionHandlers.objection: We are already locked into HubSpot / Salesforce for the next 6 to 9 months and cannot justify double-paying.

responseFramework.acknowledgement: I completely understand—nobody wants to pay for two CRM platforms at once while locked into an annual contract.
responseFramework.valueProposition: That is exactly why we run our 'Seamless Transition Bridge Program'. We will credit your HelpingHand AI licensing cost for up to 6 months to offset your remaining legacy vendor contract.
responseFramework.actionStep: We can set up your sandbox and run the 1-click migration now. Your team gets access to our autonomous voice qualification agent immediately, and your first billing cycle won't begin until your HubSpot contract formally ends.
responseFramework.suggestedClosingQuestion: If we cover the gap until your current term expires, would you be open to a 20-minute architecture review this Thursday?

salesObjectionHandlers.objection: We have strict SOC 2 and customer data governance rules. We cannot have an AI agent listening to sales calls and training on our proprietary conversations.

responseFramework.acknowledgement: Security and compliance are non-negotiable, especially when introducing AI into customer-facing conversations.
responseFramework.valueProposition: HelpingHand AI is SOC 2 Type II certified and HIPAA compliant. Under our enterprise contractual guarantee, your conversation audio and transcripts are never stored in public models or used for third-party AI training.
responseFramework.actionStep: All data is encrypted in-flight with TLS 1.3 and at-rest with AES-256. We also offer Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) and dedicated VPC isolation so you retain complete cryptographic ownership.
responseFramework.suggestedClosingQuestion: I can send over our Schellman SOC 2 Type II audit report and standard DPA/BAA package right now. Who on your InfoSec team should I copy?

salesObjectionHandlers.objection: Our sales reps hate learning new software. The last time we rolled out a new sales tool, adoption was under 30% and caused massive friction.

responseFramework.acknowledgement: That is the #1 reason CRM initiatives fail—reps want to sell, not spend two hours every evening doing manual data entry in complex software.
responseFramework.valueProposition: HelpingHand AI was built around 'Zero-Admin' philosophy. The autonomous voice agent handles prospect intake, automatically extracts BANT metrics, generates meeting notes, and updates CRM deal stages without reps typing a single line.
responseFramework.actionStep: Because it plugs directly into existing Google Meet, Zoom, and phone dialers, the learning curve is less than 30 minutes. Across our customer base, 30-day active adoption is 94%.
responseFramework.suggestedClosingQuestion: Would you like to see a live 2-minute demo of the autonomous voice agent qualifying a simulated inbound lead?

faq.question: Can the AI Voice Agent speak multiple languages?
faq.answer: Yes, HelpingHand AI natively supports real-time multi-lingual interactions including English (US, UK, Indian accents) and Hindi, dynamically detecting prospect language preferences.

faq.question: How does appointment booking work during a call?
faq.answer: The voice agent connects directly with Google Calendar and Microsoft 365, verifying rep availability in real-time and negotiating an agreed slot with the lead before sending calendar invites instantly.
